title: Oscar Castellino
shortBiography: Oscar Castellino is an international baritone, composer of Mars Anthem 'Rise to Mars', and ensemble singer at the Royal Opera House. Born in a car on a busy Mumbai street with roots tracing to Goa, Oscar's journey from software engineer to opera singer began when Patricia Rozario discovered his talent during her concert tour of India.

upcomingEvents.event: Lowest of the Low — Oscar Castellino as Ali | Arcola Theatre UK Premiere
upcomingEvents.information: Oscar Castellino sings Ali in the UK premiere of Lowest of the Low — a documentary opera based on Günter Wallraff’s exposé Ganz Unten, with music by Tuluğ Tırpan and direction by Mehmet Ergen.
upcomingEvents.description: Forty years after the publication of Ganz Unten (Lowest of the Low), Günter Wallraff’s undercover experience as a Turkish migrant worker in 1980s West Germany is transformed into a documentary opera. Oscar Castellino performs the role of Ali in Arcola Theatre’s UK premiere, with music by Tuluğ Tırpan and direction/libretto by Mehmet Ergen. Performed in English. Running time 1 hour. Age guidance 14+.

upcomingEvents.event: Così fan tutte — Outdoor Opera | Oscar Castellino as Guglielmo | Crowhurst Place
upcomingEvents.information: Barefoot Opera’s outdoor production of Mozart’s Così fan tutte at Crowhurst Place. Oscar Castellino sings Guglielmo. General admission £38.62.
upcomingEvents.description: Experience Barefoot Opera’s fresh take on Mozart and Da Ponte’s effervescent comedy outdoors at Crowhurst Place on the Big Wood Estate — a privately owned Tudor mansion and estate in Lingfield. In this production, Don Alfonso is a scientist bent on testing his thesis: ‘All women are like that’. Oscar Castellino sings Guglielmo / Ensemble. Directed by Jenny Miller. Doors open from 4pm; performance at 5pm. General admission £38.62.

upcomingEvents.event: Così fan tutte?! — Oscar Castellino as Guglielmo | Grimeborn Opera Festival
upcomingEvents.information: Oscar Castellino sings the role of Guglielmo in the Red Cast of Barefoot Opera's bold new production of Mozart's Così fan tutte, directed by Jenny Miller, as part of the Grimeborn Opera Festival. Oscar performs on 21 & 24 July only.
upcomingEvents.description:
Oscar Castellino takes on the role of Guglielmo in the Red Cast of Barefoot Opera's daring new production of Mozart's Così fan tutte, directed by Jenny Miller, as part of the celebrated Grimeborn Opera Festival at Arcola Theatre. In this reimagined production, Don Alfonso is a scientist bent on testing his thesis — a group of prototype humans are pushed through a series of experiments in human behaviour, asking urgent questions about love, loyalty and what it means to be human.

Please note: Oscar Castellino performs in the Red Cast on 21 & 24 July only. The production also runs on 22 & 25 July with the alternate cast.

upcomingEvents.contactInfo: Part of the Grimeborn Opera Festival 2026 (15 July – 5 September). For enquiries contact voice@oscarcastellino.com

upcomingEvents.event: The Marriage of Figaro — Oscar Castellino as The Count | Wilton's Music Hall
upcomingEvents.information: Oscar Castellino plays the role of The Count in Bradford Opera Festival's acclaimed production of Mozart's Marriage of Figaro at the iconic Wilton's Music Hall — relocated to 1970s Bradford and reorchestrated to weave together Western and Indian classical traditions.
upcomingEvents.description: Oscar Castellino plays the role of The Count in Bradford Opera Festival's acclaimed production of Mozart's The Marriage of Figaro at the iconic Wilton's Music Hall. Adapted by poet and broadcaster Ian McMillan and directed by Alex Chisholm, this production relocates Mozart's comic masterpiece to 1970s Bradford, blending Yorkshire dialect with a score reorchestrated by Ben Crick to incorporate both Western and Indian classical traditions. Starring Oscar Castellino, Natasha Agarwal, and Kanchana Jaishakar.

upcomingEvents.event: LISBON CONCERT Oscar Castellino | Voz de Ópera de Goa
upcomingEvents.information:
ENGLISH: Join acclaimed baritone Oscar Castellino and pianist Rodrigo Ayala for a concert that unites the grandeur of opera with the soul of Goa. Enjoy a unique program of beloved lyrical arias and traditional Luso-Goan and Konkani songs, creating a musical bridge between two cultures united by history. From the stages of the Royal Opera House to the shores of the Arabian Sea, experience a voice that carries the lyric traditions of Europe and the heart of Goa.
PORTUGUÊS: Junte-se ao aclamado barítono Oscar Castellino e ao pianista Rodrigo Ayala para um espetáculo que une a grandiosidade da ópera à alma de Goa. Para ouvir, um programa singular de árias líricas bem conhecidas do público e canções tradicionais luso-goesas e Konkani, criando uma ponte musical entre duas culturas unidas pela história. Dos palcos da Royal Opera House às margens do Mar Arábico, viva a experiência de uma voz que transporta as tradições líricas da Europa e o coração de Goa.
upcomingEvents.address: Avenida Brasília, Doca de Alcântara (Norte) | 1350-352 Lisboa, Portugal

Goan London Concert Grand YouTube Premiere
upcomingEvents.information: Free online YouTube premiere of Goan Interactions 2026 — international artists performing Goan Konkani and Portuguese music. Download the lyrics and sing along!
upcomingEvents.description: Now in its 6th year, Goan Interactions celebrates Goa's unique Konkani and Portuguese musical heritage — an evening of song, traditional mandos, Portuguese fado-adjacent numbers, and Indian classical improvisation. The Grand YouTube Premiere of the London concert streams free on 1 August 2026 at 16:30 BST. Brought to you by Melville Rodrigues and Baluji Music Foundation. Video by BGU Media. Artists: Oscar Castellino, Mark Troop, Chelsea D'Silva, Takashi Kikuchi, Manmohan Dogra, Etienne Bartholomew.
program: First Half: Jinnen Maka Sogle Dile; Tuzo Mog; Tambde Rosa; On the Spring Wind; Encosta Tua Cabecinha; Noxibak Rodtam; Toch Mhojo Ganv; Ya Ya Maya Ya
Second Half: Indian Classical Improvisation; Terra Mae; Voce Nao; The Prayer; Portuguese Medley; Adeus Korcho; Susegado Goa
upcomingEvents.contactInfo: Please download the lyrics and print and sing along. For enquiries contact voice@oscarcastellino.com
